description: Vectors of the cryptosuite iden3-jwz-rdfc-2026 (agent-passport-spec 003 Appendix C.7): user documents with real authV3-8-32 JWZ proofs, made by tools/genuserdocs.ts with js-sdk 1.46.1. Each case verifies one secured document made by signer, at now (Unix seconds), against the GIST roots the State contract held at now (states: recorded, the default; gist replaces the roots; unavailable: every read fails; none: no network accepted), with the lifetime of 7 to 14 days, and expects the proof's created and expires or the reason of C.6. documents holds signed DID document and DID configuration pairs for testvectors/proof/userdocs.json. Do not edit by hand.
